gray.prompt: Make a strictly grayscale color variant of the attached 150 by 150 pixel game portrait. This is a technical restoration, not new artwork. Preserve the exact original image, character, every facial feature, expression, line art, framing, thin border and all object positions. Desaturate the existing pixels only. Do not redraw, embellish, sharpen, replace, crop, extend, add text or alter identity. The output must be the same 150 by 150 pixel canvas, opaque PNG.

sepia.prompt: Make a strictly sepia monochrome color variant of the attached 150 by 150 pixel game portrait. This is a technical restoration, not new artwork. Preserve the exact original image, character, every facial feature, expression, line art, framing, thin border and all object positions. Apply a warm brown sepia color treatment to the existing pixels only. Do not redraw, embellish, sharpen, replace, crop, extend, add text or alter identity. The output must be the same 150 by 150 pixel canvas, opaque PNG.

postprocessing: Resize generated outputs to the existing 150x150 portrait format; original reference file unchanged.
verificationLimit: Generated color variants were visually checked but are not claimed to be pixel-identical color transforms.
